info.title: Shroudtopia API Documentation
info.description:
This page documents the native Shroudtopia C API 1.2. The operation paths organize native function calls for the ReDoc layout; they are not HTTP endpoints.

Every operation contains its exact C signature, parameter schema, result contract, and a C++ call example. The Asset section also includes static responses captured from real local Enshrouded KFC data. The documentation never connects to a local game process.

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: Exposes discoverable operations with JSON Schema inputs and observable state.

tags.name: API
tags.description: Negotiates and exposes the single flat Shroudtopia interface used by every native mod.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Lists, reads, creates, updates, patches, saves, and resets structured game assets.

tags.name: Capability information
tags.description: Describes the negotiated version and availability of a capability.

tags.name: Commands
tags.description: Registers named commands with descriptions and callbacks.

tags.name: Core API
tags.description: Defines the ABI version, common string and registration handles, and the Result error model.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Publishes typed event payloads and manages event subscriptions.

tags.name: Mod lifecycle
tags.description: Declares a mod and its load, activation, update, deactivation, and unload callbacks.

tags.name: Logging
tags.description: Writes structured loader messages and reads bounded tails of loader or game logs.

tags.name: Runtime patches
tags.description: Creates and controls ownership-scoped direct or detour runtime patches.

tags.name: Service discovery
tags.description: Publishes extension contracts and resolves providers by exact contract version.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Reads and writes typed values in the calling mod's configuration.

tags.name: UI
tags.description: Creates native text windows and registers responsive Shroudforge settings pages rendered by Win32.

**Native C function:** `api->list_assets`

**Canonical header:** `api/shroudtopia.h`

The success response contains values captured from the locally installed Enshrouded KFC files on 2026-09-17. No executable or KFC file is included.

```c
Result (CALL* list_assets)(StringView owner_id, StringView type_name, AssetVisitor visitor, void* user_data);
```

user_data.description: Opaque context forwarded unchanged to the callback.
